reason: Waits for a freshly rolled-out port to be ready (cold start, the database's first login) within (DEPLOY_SMOKE_TRIES - 1) x DEPLOY_SMOKE_SLEEP (6 tries, 5 s: 25 s). PORT-HEALTH-WAIT: the health check now asks GET /v1/health?wait_s=<what is left of the window>, which the port (http_port.ready) holds until its database answers and marks (long_poll): a held answer that is not ok yet is asked again at once while the window lasts, and red only when it is over, never before it. The sleep the scan finds is the fallback kept for an answer the port did not hold: a port older than PORT-HEALTH-WAIT (the live one until the next port deploy, which no session makes, D-054), a transport failure, or an answer in under 1 s; and the two status checks (GET /v1/deploy/status with and without a token), which run after the health is ready and keep the loop. So it is still a wait on a state on an interval while that fallback exists.
replace_with: after the next port deploy (PORT-HEALTH-WAIT live): the fallback pause of the health check goes, and the status checks ask with the long poll /v1/deploy/status already holds (?wait_s), once the port is ready
